label: Get the Job — Sales Tracker
overview: The Get the Job — Sales Tracker is a spreadsheet-based sales pipeline and performance management system (Get.1a.Sales Tracker). It creates a transparent record of sales activities, pipeline velocity, referral networks, and team performance. Five primary worksheets cover the full tracking lifecycle: firm-wide macro metrics, individual team performance, prospect-level CRM activity, centre of influence development, and system configuration. Entry-level and suitable for any advisor focused on fee growth.

diagnostic_entry.primary_question: Which area of your sales pipeline do you need to work on — tracking individual prospects, measuring team performance, managing your referral network, or reviewing your overall firm-wide conversion metrics?

support_tools.name: Stats to Date Dashboard
support_tools.purpose: A macro-level firm-wide dashboard tracking approach volumes, quiz completions, meeting conversions, proposal values, and average fee yields — segmented by approach style (Campaign vs. Total Needs) and prospect source (Referrals vs. Social Media vs. Direct Contact).
support_tools.core_principle: What gets measured gets managed. The Stats to Date dashboard makes firm-wide sales performance undeniable and objective — revealing which approach styles and lead sources are generating the highest return on time investment.
support_tools.when_to_use: At the end of each month for management review. Also used during sales strategy meetings to assess firm-wide conversion metrics and redirect effort toward the highest-yielding approach styles.
key_benefits: Reveals which sales styles (Campaign vs. Total Needs) are yielding the highest average fee values
Tracks the exact number of meetings required to generate a proposal — surfaces pipeline velocity
Distinguishes between new prospects and existing client upsells, showing whether growth is organic or external
Identifies which lead generation channels (Referrals, Social Media, Direct Contact) are producing the most agreeable prospects
support_tools.advisor_confidence_note: Review Stats to Date at the end of every month without exception. If the data shows that Total Needs campaigns yield $0 average fee, that is a signal to investigate the conversion gap — not to abandon the approach. Let the data guide your strategy, not your gut feel.

support_tools.name: Team Report
support_tools.purpose: An individual performance breakdown for each team member — tracking prospects approached, meetings secured, proposals sent, engagements won, total value secured, and win rate percentage.
support_tools.core_principle: Clear, undeniable personal metrics remove subjectivity from performance conversations. The Team Report makes it possible to identify exactly where in the sales process each advisor is losing momentum — and to intervene with targeted coaching.
support_tools.when_to_use: For one-on-one performance reviews, team accountability meetings, and identifying top performers and training needs. Also used to assign a senior 'buddy' when an advisor's conversion rate drops below expectations.
key_benefits: Individual conversion metrics make performance coaching specific and objective — not based on perception
Identifies advisors who are strong at securing meetings but weak at closing — enables targeted intervention
Benchmarks win rates across the team, revealing the performance gap between top and lower performers
Supports the decision to assign a senior partner as a 'buddy' on active prospects when conversion is low
support_tools.advisor_confidence_note: Do not wait for an annual review to surface performance gaps. Review the Team Report monthly and act on it immediately. If an advisor has a high number of approaches but a low secured conversion rate, assign a senior partner to accompany them on their next active prospect — this is peer mentoring, not criticism.

support_tools.name: Sales Activity Log
support_tools.purpose: A row-by-row CRM database for tracking individual prospect details — contact information, lead source, current sales stage, proposal value, work days elapsed, prospect status, and next follow-up actions.
support_tools.core_principle: No prospect should ever fall through the cracks. The Sales Activity Log is a daily operational tool — it is updated at the point of every approach, meeting, and follow-up. Work Days Elapsed is the key alert metric: high numbers signal a stalled deal that needs intervention.
support_tools.when_to_use: Daily, by all client-facing advisors. Every approach is logged immediately. Status is updated as the relationship progresses. Never rely on memory to manage an active pipeline.
key_benefits: Tracks follow-up dates and calculates Work Days Elapsed — gives a clear signal when a deal has stalled
Categorises leads by status (Active, Await Research, Completed, Dead, On Hold) for accurate pipeline forecasting
Provides a concrete visualisation of pending revenue — connects the sales pipeline to cash flow forecasting
Lightweight CRM function without the complexity of a standalone system — accessible to all advisors
support_tools.advisor_confidence_note: Log every approach on the same day it happens — not at the end of the week. If Work Days Elapsed exceeds 90 days without a job secured, update the status to 'On Hold' or 'Dead' and move on. Keeping stalled prospects marked as 'Active' artificially inflates your pipeline projection and distorts your strategy.

steps.name: Create a new row immediately
steps.guidance: Whenever an approach is made, log a new row in the Sales Activity Log. Fill in: prospect name, business name, lead staff member, prospect source, and approach style used.

steps.name: Update status as the relationship progresses
steps.guidance: Update Prospect Status (Active, Dead, Completed, On Hold, Await Research) after every meaningful interaction. If a proposal is requested, enter the value in the Proposal Value column.

steps.name: Monitor Work Days Elapsed
steps.guidance: Check Work Days Elapsed regularly. Deals exceeding 90 days without progress need immediate follow-up or reclassification to 'Dead' to keep the pipeline realistic.

support_tools.name: COI (Centres of Influence) Development
support_tools.purpose: A networking tracker for systematically developing referral relationships with external professionals — bankers, lawyers, insurance brokers, farm consultants — tracking relationship progression stages, referral volumes, and fee value generated.
support_tools.core_principle: Referral relationships must be nurtured systematically through trust stages before referrals can be expected. Track the fee value generated by each COI — relationships that do not progress past 'Could We' after months of effort should be deprioritised.
support_tools.when_to_use: After any networking event or coffee meeting with a potential referral partner. Updated continuously as the relationship progresses through trust stages. Reviewed monthly alongside the Stats to Date dashboard.
key_benefits: Moves COI development from informal networking to a structured, measurable process
Trust progression stages ('Could We' → 'How Would We' → 'Will We' → Test/Review) give the advisor a clear map for each relationship
Ties specific fee value to each COI relationship — makes the ROI of networking quantifiable
Prevents effort from being wasted on COIs who are cordial but never generate referrals
support_tools.advisor_confidence_note: After every networking meeting, add the contact to the COI Development tab and record the current trust stage. Update the progress indicator (1 = yes, 0 = no) as the relationship advances. If a COI has been at the 'Could We' stage for several months without movement, redirect your networking effort — not every relationship will become a referral source.

if_then_logic.condition: A new meeting is held with a commercial lender or professional and they agree to explore a mutual alliance
if_then_logic.action: Update the COI Development tab: change the relationship progress indicator from 'Could We' (1) to 'How Would We' (1).
if_then_logic.context: Relationships must move through defined trust stages. Recording each progression ensures the advisor knows exactly where every COI relationship stands.

if_then_logic.condition: A COI remains at the 'Could We' relationship stage for multiple months without generating a referral or progressing
if_then_logic.action: Redirect networking time and energy to other COIs or new referral sources.
if_then_logic.context: The COI tab ties fee value to each relationship. A COI that generates no fee value over time is not a productive referral partner.

support_tools.name: Tracker Configuration (Lists & Calcs)
support_tools.purpose: The engine room of the tracker — 'Lists' provides standardised dropdown menus ensuring data integrity across all worksheets; 'Calcs' handles background statistical calculations (Standard Deviations, Variance, Averages) that power the Stats to Date dashboard.
support_tools.core_principle: The quality of the tracker's reports depends entirely on the consistency of the data entered. Dropdown menus prevent freehand variations that corrupt statistics. Configure Lists before deploying the tracker to the team — this is a one-time setup step.
support_tools.when_to_use: Before deploying the tracker to the team for the first time. Also revisited when team members change or new meeting themes and approach styles are adopted.
key_benefits: Standardised dropdowns (Relationship Type, Approach Styles, Meeting Themes, Total Needs Stages) prevent data entry errors
Consistent categorisation ensures statistical reports are reliable enough to inform strategic decisions
Background Calcs automatically compute variance and averages without manual input from the team
One-time setup investment that protects the integrity of all future reporting
support_tools.advisor_confidence_note: Configure the Lists tab before anyone starts logging prospects. Enter the exact team members (partners and staff support), standard meeting themes, and approach styles your firm actually uses. If new themes or staff are added later, update Lists immediately — do not allow freehand entries to build up in the Activity Log.

steps.name: Populate team members
steps.guidance: Navigate to the Lists tab. Enter all partners and staff support who will be logging prospects. These names will populate the dropdown in the Sales Activity Log.

steps.name: Set meeting themes and approach styles
steps.guidance: Enter the standard meeting themes (e.g., Lite Funda' Sales, Planning Review, Formal Risk Management) and approach styles (Direct Contact, Pre-Approach Sequence, Quiz Link Sent, Gift) your firm uses.

advisor_guidance.daily_discipline: The tracker only works if it is updated daily at the point of activity. End-of-week catch-up entries are less reliable and miss nuance. Make it a non-negotiable habit: every approach is logged on the day it happens.
advisor_guidance.pipeline_hygiene: A pipeline full of stalled prospects is not an asset — it is noise. Review Work Days Elapsed weekly and reclassify stalled deals as 'On Hold' or 'Dead' promptly. A clean, realistic pipeline is more useful than an inflated one.
advisor_guidance.coi_vs_direct: Track both COI-sourced and directly-sourced leads. The Stats to Date dashboard will show you over time whether your referral network or your direct outreach is generating better quality prospects — and where to invest your BD time accordingly.

if_then_logic.condition: The prospect is generated via a 'Cold Target' or 'Social Media' source
if_then_logic.action: Start with the 'Quiz Link Sent' approach style to qualify their interest before making direct contact.
if_then_logic.context: Quizzes act as a low-friction barrier — if completed favourably, the prospect is much warmer for a follow-up call than a cold outreach alone would achieve.

if_then_logic.condition: The initial engagement is categorised under 'Lite Funda' Sales' or 'Planning Review' meeting theme
if_then_logic.action: Log the sale under the 'Campaign' sales style track.
if_then_logic.context: Campaigns are generally faster to close and require less bespoke discovery. Correct categorisation keeps the Stats to Date dashboard accurate.

if_then_logic.condition: The prospect requires a 'Full Discovery' or 'Issue Response' engagement
if_then_logic.action: Utilise the 'Total Needs' tracker and update their progress through 'Scope', 'Analyse Data', and 'Presentation' stages.
if_then_logic.context: Total Needs selling is bespoke and requires careful staging — no steps should be skipped.

if_then_logic.condition: Work Days Elapsed in the Sales Activity Log exceeds 90 days without a job being secured
if_then_logic.action: Change Prospect Status to 'On Hold' or 'Dead' and move on.
if_then_logic.context: Keeping stalled prospects marked as Active artificially inflates the pipeline projection and distorts the firm's revenue forecasting.

if_then_logic.condition: The Team Report shows an advisor has an exceptionally low Secured Conversion % despite a high number of approaches
if_then_logic.action: Assign a senior partner as 'Support Staff (Buddy)' on their next Active prospect.
if_then_logic.context: Tracking allows owners to spot conversion weaknesses and implement peer mentoring to save active deals — without waiting for an annual review.
